title: Morning Robotics Scan
report:
## HumanoidToolBench

### The Breakthrough
The authors release HumanoidToolBench, an 18‑task benchmark that evaluates a humanoid robot’s ability to select tools, manipulate, and move, backed by a 3.1k‑demo dataset collected in simulation and on a real Unitree G1, exposing large performance gaps across policies.

### The Caveats
The benchmark is presented without naming any baseline methods for comparison, so the reported performance gaps have no reference point to gauge progress.

## GlassGuard

### The Breakthrough
GlassGuard fuses a foundation vision model for glass‑instance segmentation with LiDAR cues and geometric verification, achieving 85% panoramic and 82% pinhole glass coverage while cutting false voxels by 5‑17× versus prior methods.

### The Caveats
The paper reports improvements over unnamed baselines, so it’s unclear how its performance compares to existing state‑of‑the‑art glass detection methods.

## InterEvolve

### The Breakthrough
InterEvolve lets a pre‑trained humanoid controller acquire new loco‑manipulation skills at test time by having an LLM rewrite reward programs, which are then fine‑tuned and validated across parallel simulations before running autonomously on a real Unitree G1.

### The Caveats
The paper provides no comparison to existing test‑time adaptation or reward‑learning baselines, so the reported benefits of InterEvolve remain unsubstantiated beyond a single human‑designed reward reference.

## RPG

### The Breakthrough
RPG extracts capabilities from offline data, generates practice tasks in simulation, and iteratively refines symbolic skills via a multimodal LLM, boosting success on 22 held‑out manipulation tasks from 28.6% to 95% and reporting 100% success on three real‑world trials.

### The Caveats
The reported 100 % real‑world success is based on only three tasks (30 trials), so the claim of near‑perfect embodied performance remains unverified beyond this narrow test set.

## Tesla Robotaxi Night Curfew

### The Breakthrough
Elon Musk says Tesla’s vision‑only Robotaxi struggles to detect low‑contrast objects in low light, and cites lidar and radar as hardware fixes that could extend service beyond the current 11 pm shutdown.

### The Caveats
Musk's suggestion that adding lidar will enable later night service is untested, offering no empirical data or comparison to the current vision‑only system.

## zoompilot

### The Breakthrough
zoompilot reverse‑engineers Mazda’s electric power steering to expose a speed‑dependent torque curve and fuses factory radar, blind‑spot, and speed‑limit data into the openpilot planner, delivering pre‑built releases for comma devices.

### The Caveats
The project offers only anecdotal real‑world logs with no quantitative performance or safety evaluation, leaving its claimed driver‑assistance improvements unverified.

## Vision‑Language‑Action Primer

### The Breakthrough
The essay surveys vision‑language‑action (VLA) models, highlighting Physical Intelligence’s open‑weight β0.5 VLA that extends large language models to accept text, images, and proprioception and output robot actions via a transformer.

### The Caveats
The essay provides only a conceptual overview with no empirical evaluation or benchmark comparison, so its claims about VLA models’ prevalence and effectiveness remain unverified.

## mvsim Simulator

### The Breakthrough
MRPT’s mvsim offers a lightweight 2.5D simulator with realistic differential, Ackermann, and articulated dynamics, a rich sensor suite, XML‑driven worlds, headless CI support, and ROS 1/2, ZMQ, Protobuf, and native APIs.

### The Caveats
The simulator’s claim of realistic dynamics is unsubstantiated, as the repository provides no real‑world validation or quantitative benchmark against any baseline.

## openvmp‑models CAD

### The Breakthrough
The repository provides CadQuery scripts that generate parametric 3D CAD, STL files, rendered images, and BOMs for OpenVMP robots, plus a local server for interactive editing and automatic asset updates.

### The Caveats
The repository provides no validation of its generated CAD, STL, or BOM outputs in simulation or on physical robots, so it’s unclear whether the models are functionally correct.

## Cloudflare AI‑Git Competition

### The Breakthrough
Cloudflare’s open‑beta competition invites developers to build a Git‑style platform on Workers & Artifacts, enabling programmatic repo creation, forking, and event‑driven CI for thousands of AI agents, with travel and credits for winners.

### The Caveats
The competition is merely announced with no evaluation or real‑world deployment, so the promised scalability for thousands of AI agents remains unverified.

### Priority
The HumanoidToolBench benchmark provides a concrete, data‑rich yardstick for tool‑use and mobile manipulation, grounding today’s discussion of humanoid capabilities.

### One action
Download the HumanoidToolBench dataset and benchmark scripts to evaluate your own humanoid manipulation pipeline.

### What to watch
HumanoidToolBench, InterEvolve, and RPG all target humanoid manipulation but differ in approach: the former supplies a standardized benchmark, InterEvolve focuses on test‑time reward evolution via LLMs, and RPG leverages self‑improvement loops with symbolic skills. Watching how each influences real‑world performance and cross‑paper comparisons will reveal the most scalable path forward.
